proposals.evidence: CDIAL 13544.2 *sūṅkara gives Kumauni sũgar, Nepali sũgar/sũgur and western Pahari suṅgur pig. The Dotyali velar-nasal forms fit this specifically nasal branch; vowel differences and weakening/loss of the oral velar after ŋ are retained. Turner calls the reconstruction partly onomatopoeic; local transmission remains unresolved. Exact response: sũŋər̃.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 9237.2 *billa gives Sindhi ḇilo, Punjabi/Hindi billā and Hindi bilrā cat. The selected Dotyali billo/billu and Tharu bilra match this contracted branch, with regional final vowel variation; the link leaves local Indo-Aryan transmission unresolved. Exact response: billo.
